text:
Alex: Heads-up — enterprise POC (PCI scope) asking for a detailed KMS/HSM rotation playbook and SIG/CAIQ snippets. Can someone help pull a short, evidence-backed response? @Maya @Priya

deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned: poc-acme-2026 (id: p-9a8b). Upload URL will be available after artifact bundle is ready.

Jorge: I can draft the SIG answers. Quick clarifying Qs: customer wants BYOK + monthly rotation proof. We support CMKs (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK) and HSM import for Private — is that correct?

Maya: Yep. Short summary to use in SIG: we use envelope encryption (data key encrypted by a wrapping key). Options: (1) Redwood-managed wrapping key, (2) customer-managed CMK (BYOK) via KMS/CMEK, (3) HSM integration (KMIP / import token) for Private.

Maya: Rotation specifics: Redwood rotates service wrapping keys on a monthly cadence internally. Customer CMKs remain under customer control and rotation schedule (we can trigger rewraps and show timestamps). For PCI, rotation frequency depends on policy/risk — many customers pick 90 days or 1 year; we can support automated 30/90/365 day schedules and on-demand rotation.

Priya: Add these evidence items for vendor risk reviewers: HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3), KMS audit logs (API calls + key rotation events), sample rotation CSV (key_id, action, user, timestamp), and the CAIQ mapping doc that links our controls to SIG questions. We should redact ARNs in shared logs.

Jorge: Can you paste a compact SIG/snippet we can drop into the questionnaire?

Maya: Paste below — compress for SIG answer:
- At-rest: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption. Data keys generated per-request and wrapped with wrapping key (customer CMK or Redwood service key).
- In-transit: TLS1.2+ (tls1.3 preferred). Mutual TLS available for Private deployments.
- Key management: Support for CMK (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK), BYOK import tokens, KMIP for HSMs. Customer may manage key rotation or delegate to Redwood with agreed rotation cadence.
- Rotation: Manual or automated. Automated policy example: `rotationSchedule: 'P30D'` (30 days) or `P90D`. Rotation proof: rotation events exported with key_id + new_key_version + timestamp.
- HSM: We support HSM-backed wrapping keys for Dedicated/Private; FIPS attestation available on request.
- Evidence: KMS audit logs, rotation event exports, HSM certs/attestations, CAIQ control mapping.

Alex: This is great. Customer also asked whether we ever export key material. Need a one-liner: do we ever export wrapping keys?

Sam: Short answer: no — we never export Redwood service wrapping key material. For BYOK, customer can export/import per their provider process (e.g., AWS import token); Redwood does not retain plaintext key material. We can provide key IDs and rotation timestamps but not raw key material.

Priya: I'll prepare a sanitized rotation log sample (CSV) and a short note that explains where events live in our audit stream (CloudTrail-like export). I'll remove ARNs and replace with tokenized IDs.

Sam: I'll collect HSM certs, FIPS attestation PDFs, and an example KMS rotation export (12 months) and drop them into the secure upload. Who should I whitelist for access?

Alex: Whitelist: jorge@redwood, maya@redwood, priya@redwood, ae@redwood. Also include the AE's manager. Customer will receive a limited bundle.

Jorge: I'll assemble the SIG answers and clearly mark the split: "Customer responsibility" vs "Redwood responsibility" for each control (e.g., key rotation, key custody, export). That usually smooths vendor risk review.

Maya: One more note for the SIG: include the process for emergency rotation (compromise): we can rotate service wrapping keys and rewrap data keys; for customer CMKs we provide instructions and support to rotate and rewrap. Add contact path and SLA for emergency key ops.

Alex: Timeline: can we get the artifact bundle + SIG draft by EOD tomorrow? Customer wants to submit vendor review within 48 hours.

Priya: EOD tomorrow works. I'll draft rotation CSV + CAIQ mapping and a short blurb on export policy.

Sam: I'll upload certs and attestation PDFs to the secure bucket once Priya gives the whitelist.

Jorge: I'll draft the SIG answers tonight and put in the shared doc for review in the morning.

Alex: Awesome — thanks team. I'll update the customer timeline after we confirm artifacts. :thumbsup:
